Follow the poled route from Hope Kiwi Lodge along the forest edge to the Hope River swingbridge about 30 minutes from the hut.
Five minutes down a shingle road is the shelter and car park at Windy Point, beside SH 7.

doubts: The Hurunui swing bridge start has no feature or name entry, so its ref is null. Windy Point car park is F1 (an unnamed track meeting Lewis Pass Road); the text places the car park beside SH 7 at the end of a shingle road, so the match is probable but not certain. Loch Katrine is an access point only: the text says walkers may use the 4WD track from it (the locked gate has no foot restriction), but it is not described as a way start. The main way's DOC time (18 hr 30 min) is given as is, although the three leg times add to 11 hr 30 min. The Windy Point to Hope Kiwi Lodge way (W2) is a reverse-direction description with its own headings, so it is a separate way; it has no whole-way time (legs 4 hr and 3 hr only), so time is null. Cross the stream is marked ford for Three Mile Stream because no bridge is mentioned. Which lake the Kiwi Saddle lookout views is not named.
